---
title: "Reference Map - Philadelphia Shootings"
author: "Kieran Hefferan"
date: "2026-06-07"
output: html_document
---

```{r data-load}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

# Read Philly shooting GeoJSON
phillyShootings <- na.omit(
  st_read("https://pengdsci.github.io/STA553VIZ/w08/PhillyShootings.geojson"))

# Optional neighborhood boundary layer from case study
phillyNeighbor <- st_read(
  "https://pengdsci.github.io/STA553VIZ/w08/Neighborhoods_Philadelphia.geojson"
)

# Make sure spatial data use latitude/longitude
phillyShootings <- st_transform(phillyShootings, 4326)
phillyNeighbor <- st_transform(phillyNeighbor, 4326)

# Create color palette for fatal/nonfatal shootings
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("Fatal" = "red", "Nonfatal" = "orange"),
  domain = phillyShootings$fatal
)

# Interactive reference map
leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light Map") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%

  # Philly neighborhood boundaries
  addPolygons(
    data = phillyNeighbor,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 0.6,
    group = "Neighborhood Boundaries"
  ) %>%

  # Individual shooting locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = phillyShootings,
    radius = 4,
    color = ~pal(fatal),
    fillColor = ~pal(fatal),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    stroke = FALSE,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>Fatal:</strong> ", fatal, "<br>",
      "<strong>Date:</strong> ", date_, "<br>",
      "<strong>Age:</strong> ", age, "<br>",
      "<strong>Sex:</strong> ", sex, "<br>",
      "<strong>Race:</strong> ", race
    ),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(),
    group = "Shooting Locations"
  ) %>%

  # Heat map showing concentration
  addHeatmap(
    data = phillyShootings,
    radius = 18,
    blur = 25,
    max = 0.05,
    group = "Shooting Density"
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = phillyShootings$fatal,
    title = "Shooting Type"
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Light Map", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Neighborhood Boundaries",
      "Shooting Locations",
      "Shooting Density"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) 
```
